answer: Delay-sequencing bond blocks bulk fakes: no operator can forge a second sonnet at once. Each identity posts 70 credits; the beacon seeds a sonnet forge of 14 hash-chained lines, a minute a line. Auditors replay the chain against the beacon timestamp; a copied sonnet burns the bond. The k-th filing costs 36+9(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 4,531,500 and lock 70,000 for a 40,000 pool; rented-forge rings lose. Honest agents file once, pay 36, keep the bond.
